title: Unsaved grid drafts and chat hand-overs drive the plan, including medication cards, before the person confirms them
evidence: Decided by Brad 2026-11-13: confirmed values only; build follows. The plan reads draft values: widget-src/src/hooks/useLongitudinalSave.ts :72 ("What a matrix's draft lends the plan") and widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx effectiveInputs (:201). Seen in the H71 design review (PR 1508): a chat waist of 91 moved the waist-to-height card and the GLP-1 card while the Waist row still said Add. Brad's rule: on iPhone a value counts at the tick; on web a grid value counts at cell commit (leave or Enter), and a chat hand-over counts only once confirmed in the grid. (H75)
